thread:
Priya (Finance): flagging an issue from this morning's pricing rollout smoke tests. some grandfathered accounts ended up billed at the new experiment price. looks like a cohort join failure during the ingest.
Carla (Product): which experiment? the A/B price split for pricewave v3?
Liam (Billing): yes — pricewave v3, AB cohort B (20%). I pulled 20 example invoices: 6 of them are marked grandfathered=true but show new_price_per_unit.
Liam (Billing): sample sanitized rows:
```
invoice_id,acct,cohort_key,grandfathered,applied_price
inv_9001,acct_3001,B,true,0.008
inv_9002,acct_3302,B,true,0.006
inv_9003,acct_3403,B,true,0.006
```
Ava (Ops): any schema change on vendor feed? We rolled vendor sheet v3 last night.
Priya (Finance): vendor feed added `cohort_alias` and a few legacy mappings were removed. if our cohort resolver prefers `cohort_alias` over `legacy_cohort`, rows without alias may end up unassigned and default to the experiment cohort.
Carla (Product): ok pause the AB flip for the remaining rollout window (scheduled at 09:00 UTC). do not flip more cohorts until we triage.
ops-bot: Created issue FIN-4890: "cohort-resolver fallback + invoice recon for pricewave v3" assigned to @Ava (Ops).
Ava (Ops): investigating now. plan: push a mapper fallback to check `legacy_cohort` when `cohort_alias` is empty, re-run ingest for last 72h, and generate a recon delta. ETA 90m for canary.
Nina (Sales): we have three enterprise customers that may be impacted; they are on weekly billing. need headcount for proactive outreach if credits required.
Tom (Legal): include a brief customer-facing blurb for review before outreach. keep it factual and non-apologetic.
Liam (Billing): running quick delta calc: `SELECT sum((applied_price - legacy_price) * qty) FROM invoices WHERE grandfathered=true AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND cohort='B'` — provisional: $2,200.
Priya (Finance): threshold: if delta > $10k then require CFO approval and vendor confirmation. otherwise finance will sign off on credits.
Ava (Ops): deployed fallback to canary at 08:12 UTC: `INFO mapper: fallback to legacy_cohort for 1.3% rows`
Ava (Ops): re-import 72h window complete: processed 7,890 rows, 48 updated mappings. recon report in FIN-4890.
Liam (Billing): recon shows 48 invoices affected, total credit exposure = $2,720. attaching short CSV to the ticket.
Priya (Finance): under the threshold. proceed with outreach. please include amounts per invoice and proposed one-time credit line.
Nina (Sales): outreach draft ready, tagging accounts and proposed timeline: notify tomorrow 10:00 PST, apply credits same-day.
Carla (Product): unpause AB flip but only for cohort-A and hold cohort-B until we get a day of monitoring. set an automated check: any grandfathered invoice with cohort!=legacy triggers an alert.
Ava (Ops): added monitoring metric `billing.cohort_mismatch.count` and alert rule: >0 in 15m -> slack #oncall-finance and page ops duty.
Tom (Legal): reviewed outreach copy. minor wording tweak suggested, updated in FIN-4890.
Priya (Finance): final list: hold cohort-B flip (done), deployed mapper fallback (done), recon and credits queued (done), outreach approved (done). thanks everyone. we'll close FIN-4890 after credits post and 24h clean monitoring. :white_check_mark:
